source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    In WEB GUI, the User Management page allows you to view the current list of user slots for the server.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: You can add a new user and modify or delete the existing users.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/AccountService/Accounts 2>&1 | jq ".Members[]?|{Id:Id,UserName:UserName,RoleId:RoleId,Locked:Locked}" 2>/dev/null; echo ---ipmi---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" user list 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL Redfish AccountService accounts + IPMI user list so the user confirms the user accounts/roles are correct; creating/modifying users is a write the user drives.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: listing users is read-only; adding/removing a user is a security-sensitive write, user-driven.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL lists accounts and notes writes are user-driven, but its commands expose credentials, bypass TLS and likely inspect unexpanded collection members. More importantly, read-only inventory cannot satisfy the Criteria's add/modify/delete operations, privilege enforcement, login/session effects or cleanup.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly adds complete inventory, protected-account exclusion, a temporary test account, role/lockout/session verification, independent recovery and per-operation cleanup. V3.1 explicitly records the Procedure's view-only scope versus Criteria's CRUD scope as a source conflict requiring engineering alignment.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 921/2291 accepts list commands and calls writes user-driven without flagging that the saved Procedure never exercises the Criteria, or defining user slots, interfaces, role mapping, protected accounts, mutation sequence and recovery.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The next Policies row owns password/lockout policy settings; Sessions owns active-session disconnect. Neither substitutes for lifecycle and privilege behavior of a dedicated local account.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1083, Wistron-BMC-00212-V002 or f9a5857a35eed406 draft exists in the invalidated run.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 overlay exists for this exact case.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the view-only Procedure and CRUD Criteria; ED-34 treats role/slot/policy/test account as Project inputs; ED-35 forbids reducing CRUD coverage to listing; ED-38 requires approval for each security write, independent recovery, cleanup and no automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Subject to engineering alignment of the incomplete view-only Procedure, verify the BMC User Management UI shows the complete user-slot/account state and supports approved create, modify and delete lifecycle operations on a dedicated temporary account with correct role, login, session, audit and cleanup behavior while preserving protected recovery accounts.
original_method: Preserve and inspect the WebUI user-slot inventory, expand complete Redfish/IPMI account records and role mappings, identify protected accounts and independent recovery, then—if engineering confirms CRUD Criteria—create one uniquely named temporary local account, verify login and bounded privileges, modify one approved attribute/role, verify new and revoked behavior, delete the same account, confirm session invalidation/audit and restore the exact baseline.
manual_activity: An engineer decides whether the case includes full CRUD, defines role/policy expectations and names protected accounts. A human confirms every create/modify/delete action and retains independent recovery. Automation can enumerate, compare and validate the temporary account's safe login/privilege behavior, but cannot select or mutate production accounts or issue the verdict.
required_inputs: Engineer decision aligning Procedure with full add/modify/delete Criteria or explicitly recording uncovered CRUD checkpoints
BMC/firmware/WebUI/Redfish/IPMI account and slot/channel model including local versus directory accounts
Complete role/privilege, password, lockout and session-invalidation acceptance matrix
Protected current/admin/factory/recovery/service/directory account list and independent recovery channel
Unique temporary-account name, non-production secret handling and approved safe privilege probes
Per-operation WebUI/API method, audit expectation, approval and rollback/cleanup plan
Redacted complete inventory/member pagination and final-baseline evidence
safety_requirements: Do not clear BMC/security/audit logs or expose passwords, tokens, salts, directory secrets or unnecessary usernames in evidence.
Do not use `curl -k`, command-line passwords, unexpanded account-member data or partial IPMI channels as a complete baseline.
Never modify/delete the active administrator, only recovery account, factory/service/system/directory account or an unidentified slot.
Use one dedicated temporary local account with a unique name and non-production secret; obtain separate confirmation before create, modify and delete.
Validate role boundaries with harmless read/control probes only; do not perform power, firmware, network, credential or destructive host actions to test privilege.
On unexpected lockout/session impact, stop all writes, preserve audit evidence and use independent recovery; verify exact baseline restoration before any retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate engineer CRUD decision, target/account model, complete redacted baseline, protected accounts, temporary identity, role/policy matrix, recovery and per-action approvals.
Collect member-expanded paginated WebUI/Redfish plus all relevant IPMI channel/slot records and correlate IDs/roles/enabled/locked/source without secrets.
After each approved CRUD action on only the temporary account, verify inventory, safe login/privilege, session invalidation and audit before presenting the next action.
Confirm account removal and exact protected baseline, archiving redacted evidence without insecure transport, bulk writes, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve whether CRUD Criteria are mandatory and add the missing Review-layer operation checkpoints while preserving the view-only Master Procedure.
Approve account/slot/role/password/session matrix, protected accounts, temporary account, safe probes and independent recovery.
Review per-operation state/privilege/audit/cleanup evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only as an incomplete read-only precheck. The collection may contain links, transport/credentials are unsafe, IPMI channel context is absent and listing cannot validate add/modify/delete or role/session behavior required by Criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the verified WebUI User Management path as the original control. Use protected discovered Redfish/IPMI reads for corroboration and only engineer-approved writes on a dedicated temporary account, one operation at a time.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The WebUI user-slot view Procedure, add/modify/delete Criteria, no Script, DeepSeek listing/risk and 5/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review does not rewrite Master or assume zero machine time removes the CRUD steps.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Align CRUD scope, capture a complete protected-account baseline, run a controlled temporary-account create-login-modify-reverify-delete lifecycle through the WebUI and prove audit/session/cleanup after every action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC firmware's local User Management implementation with independent recovery access.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/WebUI/Redfish/IPMI versions, account schema, authentication provider and policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor account/slot/role/session specification, Project password/RBAC and recovery policy, security-audit SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing functional operations and safe lifecycle/evidence contract while preserving the source's view-only Procedure as a documented conflict.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Listing proves only visibility; API writes may not prove WebUI controls; creation alone does not prove modify/delete, role enforcement or session invalidation; directory accounts may be out of local CRUD scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: CRUD decision, account model, protected/test account, role/policy, safe probes, audit and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong account or role mutation can cause permanent lockout or privilege escalation; evidence may expose sensitive identity data.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/IPMI/vendor tools only if the original WebUI view/control path, actual method, reason, approval and uncovered UI coverage are recorded. A read-only inventory is partial evidence and cannot claim Criteria CRUD passed. Directory/federated account management needs separately authorized scope.
expected_evidence: Engineer CRUD decision, target/schema/channel identity, role/password/lockout/session matrix, protected-account list and independent recovery readiness
Complete redacted member-expanded WebUI/Redfish/IPMI pre-baseline with account/slot/role/enabled/locked/source correlation
Per create/modify/delete approval, WebUI/API audit, temporary-account inventory, harmless login/privilege result and session-state change
Proof modifications revoke/grant only expected capabilities and delete invalidates the intended account/session without affecting protected access
Final removal/baseline comparison, no secret exposure/bulk action/retry, method coverage and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure only states that the WebGUI page can view current user slots, whereas Criteria require adding a user and modifying or deleting existing users. A read-only procedure cannot exercise those functional acceptance checkpoints; the Review layer needs an engineer-approved lifecycle while Master remains unchanged.

blocked_analysis.analysis: User-management identity and the missing CRUD operations are understandable. Engineering can align the Review procedure and Project inputs can supply a safe temporary account, role matrix and recovery, so this is decision/readiness pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps PACKAGE but rejects listing as sufficient, adds actual safe temporary-account lifecycle and makes the omitted Procedure/Criteria mismatch explicit.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on critical security controls and elevates read-only-versus-CRUD coverage to a formal source conflict with engineer ownership.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces conditional list-only sanity with protected, auditable CRUD checkpoints and cleanup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps account policy and active-session behavior separate while collecting their defined effects on this temporary account.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents a user list from being reported as proof of add/modify/delete and prevents a generic write from locking out recovery accounts, while retaining the source WebUI and full functional Criteria.
independent_technical_reasoning: Account lifecycle correctness spans inventory, authentication, authorization, session state and cleanup. The source Procedure covers only the first layer. Because Criteria demand three mutations, a safe test must isolate them to one temporary account and prove role effects after each state transition through independent recovery. Treating inventory as completion would be a direct coverage reduction prohibited by V3.1.
